_note: Single authority for every visual block. The Director prompt, the validator and the compiler are all built from this file. To change a block, change it here and in its HTML file together.

safe_band_px._why: Instagram/TikTok draw their own UI above 168 px and below 1330 px; every word must sit inside this band.

placeholders.__ID__: the instance id (host id = scene root id = timeline key; HyperFrames requires all three to match)
placeholders.<!--GROUPS-->: captions only: the timed caption groups written by the compiler

face_cut.label: Talking head (a cut of the proxy)
face_cut.purpose: The speaker. Every second of the reel has a face_cut under it, except full-screen cards.

cy.help: zoom centre y (0-1); keep the face high

captions.label: Word-pop captions (Arabic, 1-3 words)
captions.purpose: Every spoken word, in groups of up to 3, built from the transcript by the compiler. The Director only chooses keyword word indices.

groups.help: compiler writes groups from transcript words; keywords turn lime + heavier + pop

hook_two_tone.label: Hook title, two tones (white line + lime line)
hook_two_tone.purpose: Frame 0 must already show the hook. Used once, at the very start.

line2.help: lime line on the violet bar, the strongest word(s)

text_card.label: Kinetic text card (full screen)
text_card.purpose: A chapter title or key claim. Hides the face; voice continues underneath.
rules: chapter card every 15-20 s on long reels

split.label: Split: card on top, face below
split.purpose: Shows a number or short point while the face stays visible (face moves to the lower half).

value.help: a number exactly as spoken (Western digits), or empty

label.help: what the number or point is

rules: value only if the number is actually spoken

flash.label: Lime flash + one word/number
flash.purpose: The payoff moment. Full-screen lime, one big dark word or number.

word.help: one word or number, as spoken

logo_card.label: Logo card (one logo, or a pair)
logo_card.purpose: Names a tool/brand/platform when he says it. Logos only from the reel's assets/ folder.

logo_a.help: file in the job's assets/ folder

rules: logo must exist in job assets/

cta_card.label: CTA card (last beat; one version per platform)
cta_card.purpose: The ending: follow (default) or comment-a-keyword. Over the face with a dark scrim. Handle appears only here.

promise.help: the reason to follow / what they get

keyword.help: comment keyword, only for comment-CTA reels
